create.title: Exact lower-radial phase diagram below the critical sector
create.statement_tex: Let N=X^nu, D=X^delta, and L=X^ell. Stationary support gives ell=delta+(nu-1)/2 and (1-nu)/2<=delta<=1/2. The terminal theorem is exactly nu=1/2; V2 closes exactly (nu,delta)=(0,1/2); and the TTY wedge becomes 1816delta+89nu<=552, first meeting active support at (nu,delta,ell)=(356/819,463/1638,0). This contact is only partial scale coverage. The accepted direct menu closes every active denominator scale only at nu=0 and nu=1/2. Every 0<nu<1/2 retains the hard-top block (delta,ell)=(1/2,nu/2). On a residual block the exact excess above X^(1/4) for the best accepted menu is min((1-2nu)/4,(1816delta+89nu-552)/2564,delta-1/4,nu/4); at the hard top it is min(nu/4,(1-2nu)/4), crossing at nu=1/3. Floors, hard top, stars, smooth Mellin multipliers, and logarithmic scale sums preserve the reduction.
create.next_action: Exploit h/H_j tending to zero on every fixed subcritical radial slice. Prove the exact Phi(u)=1+O(u^2) and denominator-partition collapse, quantify its total error, and isolate the resulting one-sided character-divisor radial sum.

update.next_action: The critical radial sector and the degenerate nu=0 endpoint are closed, but every 0<nu<1/2 retains a hard-top survivor. Attack the small-angle angular-symbol collapse and its one-sided character-divisor radial remainder; do not infer all-scale closure from the TTY prefix.
Use the accepted radial pullback of U_1. The TTY contact nu=356/819 is only partial low-D coverage; every fixed 0<nu<1/2 retains the top scale.
Keep this theorem scoped to fixed critical radial support. Below nu=1/2, use the exact lower-radial diagram and the small-angle Vaaler structure rather than extending terminal support.

reject.reason: The value 356/819 is only where the TTY-covered low-D prefix first meets active support. The actual hard-top block remains outside TTY for every 0<nu<1/2.
The exact angular coefficient sums every active denominator profile. Existence of one target-sized scale gives no estimate for the remaining scales without an additional signed cross-scale theorem.
The terminal condition ell=delta-1/4 is equivalent to nu=1/2. For fixed nu<1/2, h/H_j tends to zero and the terminal bound loses X^((1-2nu)/4) over the target.

no_change.reason: The entire open lower-radial band 0<nu<1/2 still contains an unproved hard-top block.
The phase diagram is a reduction and supplies no new cancellation estimate or exponent improvement.

round_assessment.reason: Round 61 gives an exact, independently validated map of every accepted M1 input into radial coordinates and identifies the unavoidable hard-top survivor and exact missing powers. It prevents a false threshold claim and focuses the next proof attack, but proves no new bound.
